changelog:
Added:
- Settings: a Changelog panel right under App Updates showing your last releases, so version history stays visible in-app instead of being lost when the update manifest resets.
- Intiface device control now supports rotating toys (Kiiroo Onyx/Titan, Vorze Cyclone/UFO, We-Vibe Nova) and oscillating/thrusting toys (Fun Factory Stronic line).

Changed:
- The Handy integration now uses REST API v3 (HSP streaming protocol) instead of the old v2 HDSP commands. Requires firmware 4+ (original Handy 1 works once updated).

Fixed:
- Handy v3: corrected auth header and fixed snake_case field names in HSP requests that were being rejected silently.
